title: Cloud Security: portfolio usage
content:
Cloud Security portfolio usage is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

Use posted portfolio primary usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount.

Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed.

No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts.

The threshold comparison is inclusive.

Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

The portfolio measurement window is the source UTC calendar month, matching the customer and legal billing entity of the proposed charge.

For that measurement, sum posted primary quantities net of source reversals by holding. Multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier rate and regional multiplier before any discount or tax, then total across Cloud Security. Exclude ancillary meters and do not sum already discounted invoices.

## Basis Q&A

**Is a portfolio discount a cash credit?**

Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Portfolio boundary

Hypothetical case: the eligible posted primary usage subtotal is exactly the portfolio threshold. The threshold test passes; the discount still requires the absence of a higher-priority price.
